payment_failed_no_money: You don't have enough money to pay for this item.
transaction_complete_message: Thank you for shopping with us!
dirk_lib_discord_intro: Bot credentials used by lib.discord across every dirk_lib consumer. Leave blank to disable Discord-backed features (role lookups, member queries, etc.) — they'll surface a 'configure here' message instead of failing.
dirk_lib_discord_token_tooltip: Discord bot token. Server-side only — never sent to clients.
dirk_lib_discord_guild_tooltip: Discord server (guild) ID the bot operates against by default.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step1_body: Sign in with the Discord account that owns the server you want the bot to operate in.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step2_body: Click 'New Application', give it a name (this becomes the bot's display name), and confirm.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step3_body: Open the 'Bot' tab → click 'Reset Token' → copy the token and paste it into the Bot Token field above. The token is shown only once.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step4_body: Still on the Bot tab, scroll to 'Privileged Gateway Intents' and toggle 'Server Members Intent' on. Required for role / member lookups.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step5_body: OAuth2 → URL Generator → tick 'bot' scope, leave permissions empty (read-only is fine), open the generated URL and add the bot to your server.
dirk_lib_discord_guide_step6_body: Enable Developer Mode in Discord (User Settings → Advanced), right-click your server icon → 'Copy Server ID' and paste into the Guild ID field above.
dirk_lib_appearance_base_tooltip: Generates the full 10-shade palette. Click any shade below to fine-tune.
dirk_lib_branding_name_tooltip: Displayed in NUIs that surface a server name
dirk_lib_localization_language_tooltip: Locale code used when resolving /locales strings
dirk_lib_localization_symbol_tooltip: Prefix used when rendering money values
dirk_lib_bridging_framework_tooltip: Server framework dirk_lib reads player data from.
dirk_lib_bridging_inventory_tooltip: Inventory system used for item lookups, give/remove, and image paths.
dirk_lib_bridging_imgpath_tooltip: Inventory image path. 'auto' resolves from the detected inventory; override with a full nui://… or CDN URL.
dirk_lib_bridging_interact_tooltip: Interact-prompt system used as the alternative to target-based interactions.
dirk_lib_bridging_phone_tooltip: Phone resource (used for messages, mail, etc.).
dirk_lib_groups_dist_tooltip: Max metres between players for an invite to land
dirk_lib_groups_valid_tooltip: Minutes an outstanding invite stays valid before expiring
dirk_lib_groups_logoff_tooltip: Minutes a player can stay offline before being auto-kicked from their group
dirk_lib_advanced_primary_tooltip: Player identifier used as the primary lookup key. Default 'license' works for the vast majority of servers.
dirk_lib_advanced_debug_desc: Enables verbose dirk_lib logging and opt-in SQL/hitch diagnostics. Leave off in production.
script_config_section_master_tooltip: Set via the `dirk_lib_master_group` server convar in your server.cfg. Anyone with this ACE permission can edit any registered scriptConfig and bypass overrides. Cannot be edited from the panel by design — if you lock yourself out via overrides, the convar is your escape hatch.
script_config_section_overrides_tooltip: Grant additional access to specific resources for non-master groups or individual players. Purely additive — overrides cannot remove access from the master.
script_config_section_no_overrides: No overrides — only the master group can edit configs.
script_config_section_resource_tooltip: Which scriptConfig-registered resource this override applies to.
script_config_section_groups_tooltip: ACE permission strings checked via IsPlayerAceAllowed (e.g. group.mod, dirkscripts.command.druglabs). Press Enter to add.
script_config_section_identifiers_toolti: Specific player identifiers granted access regardless of group membership. Pick from the online-players dropdown or paste a known identifier (license:..., steam:..., etc.).
